data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'Hrowan', meaning 'little red one' or 'rowan tree'. In ancient Celtic mythology, the rowan tree was considered sacred and protective. The name Rowen carries the meaning “Little Red One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rowen usually hope their child will grow to embody little red one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rowen total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
